sections.title: What do empty places cost you?
sections.lead: Put in your numbers. See how many places go empty, and what people who say yes and don’t turn up cost you each event and each month.

sections.title: Work out what no-shows cost you.
sections.lead: Every figure here comes from what you put in. Slide the second rate to see your own what-if.

If guests pay when they book, a no-show has already paid, and your cancellation policy decides what’s refunded. Paid booking, a waitlist that moves and a message before the day are what you can change; how far your rate falls is yours to judge.

sections.title: The sums, in plain words.
sections.lead: Your estimate, not a promise: you set both rates. {{brand.name}} doesn’t publish a no-show rate for its hosts.

items.title: What you don’t collect
items.body: If people pay at the door or later, every no-show is a held place nobody paid for. That’s empty places × ticket price.

items.title: Free events
items.body: Nothing to collect, but each empty place still costs you what you spent on it: empty places × what each place costs you.

items.title: Your what-if
items.body: The same sums at the rate you slide to. The difference is what that rate would be worth to you, not a result anyone promises.

sections.title: Four things to try, on {{brand.name}} or anywhere.

items.title: Pay to book
items.body: A price, even a small one, asks people to decide when they book, not on the day.
items.fix: On {{brand.name}}, guests pay by UPI or card when they book.

items.title: A clear policy
items.body: Say what’s refunded and until when, before anyone books.
items.fix: Set a cancellation policy for each event, and refunds follow it.

items.title: A message that helps
items.body: Where to be, when, and who to look for, before the day.
items.fix: Message everyone who booked from the app.

items.title: A waitlist that moves
items.body: People who cancel ahead free a place for someone who wants it.
items.fix: On a free event the next person moves up; on a paid one, send them an offer.

sections.title: Take payment when people book.
sections.lead: Start the free trial, or book a walkthrough and we’ll set it up with you.
